arcs.title: The Biscuit Tin Endgame
arcs.summary: Day 3: A third object — the good wooden spoon — has been found placed equidistant from the oven mitt and the biscuit tin, forming a precise isoceles triangle with the tin at the apex. Pemwick has measured it and confirmed the geometry. The household now understands they are not the investigators; they are the subjects. No biscuit is missing. Day 4 (resolution): Lucy should complete her operation — either a biscuit disappears with zero trace and zero evidence at all (her masterwork), or the tin is found open and perfectly re-closed with no indication of how, and Lucy is discovered in an entirely different room, looking entirely elsewhere, having been there apparently all morning. The resolution should be funny, earned, and leave Lucy's guilt absolutely certain and absolutely unprovable. Pemwick files a final report. Quoyne reads it. The annex is accepted into the registry, reluctantly, because it is extremely precise.
